content: The lizard that jumped safely from the towering iroko tree said he would praise himself if nobody else did.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Igbo Proverb (Things Fall Apart — Chinua Achebe)
explanation: When you have survived an impossible trial, overcome a terrifying leap of faith, or quietly mastered a monumental hardship, the crowd may not notice or applaud. Do not let external silence diminish your victory. Nod to your own heart and give quiet praise.
practicalInsight: Acknowledge a quiet personal victory today that nobody else saw. Honor your own courage.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you constantly look to others for validation, instead of honoring the quiet victories you achieve alone?
